recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed; future changes to the bd definition should go through the terminology/THO maintenance path rather than reintroducing a core CodeSystem source file.
issue_request: FHIR-12135 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request to clarify location-physical-type code bd from a generic sleeping/laying space to a space that may hold a bed/trolley, not the movable physical bed/trolley itself.
initial_application: Commit 6b1a596ff1, whose subject names tracker 12135, changed source/location/codesystem-location-physical-type.xml so bd display Bed gained the requested physical bed/trolley clarification.
additional_context: Current Location remains active in source/fhir.ini and Location.form binds to ValueSet/location-form. That value set now composes codes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/location-physical-type. Commit 5c0494aacf later removed UTG/THO-maintained CodeSystem content from core, deleting the local location-physical-type CodeSystem source after it already contained the FHIR-12135 wording. The linked Zulip thread supports interpreting bd as a bed place/space, and no conflicting Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The active core source delegates the relevant code definitions to THO, and the current THO CodeSystem-location-physical-type JSON has code bd with exactly the accepted FHIR-12135 definition.
